sections.title: Human Value and Multi-Agent Session Continuity

todos.content: Identify and correct the session-persistence discontinuity so a human can reliably return to Jasper, Coding, Research, and future agent-profile conversations, decisions, visual artifacts, and workspace context across server and UI restarts.
todos.notes: Top-priority blocker because session continuity preserves the human's prior worktime, attention, mental energy, and token cost. Root cause correction on 2026-08-02: the Docker PostgreSQL database retained Jasper thread 019fbf63-9194-7ca3-843d-1eea1acab82a with 91 checkpoints and retained the requested governance conversation 019fbf91-b2af-7012-83cf-2ca48ae09d88. A manually started langgraph dev process on the same port exposed a separate local catalog, creating a false appearance of data loss. Added a documented Agent Server custom /runtime-identity route marked only by the Docker deployment; the UI now verifies backend-postgres-v1 before constructing the LangGraph SDK stream and blocks unverified development runtimes. Removed the root README dev-server launch path, restored the Docker/PostgreSQL Agent Server, and verified the recovered Jasper thread through the API. Focused backend, TypeScript, production-build, lint, and browser guard tests pass. The broader acceptance remains: durable production backing must recover transcripts, all agent-participation records and delegations, many-to-many workspace relationships, decisions, model-use records, and visual artifacts after process and machine restarts. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

todos.content: Define the production many-to-many Workspace, Session, WorkspaceSessionLink, and profile-agnostic AgentParticipation contracts so one workspace can retain many sessions, one knowledge-work session can reference several workspaces, and Jasper, Coding, Research, or any future approved profile can contribute with explicit roles, versions, delegations, revisions, time bounds, decisions, outcomes, and artifacts.
todos.notes: Implementation began 2026-08-02 under the Visual Session Library plan. Keep portable workspace identity separate from device-local filesystem bindings. Agent participation uses stable profile IDs and versions rather than fixed Jasper/Coding/Research columns, preserving future profiles and historical readability. LangGraph checkpoints retain thread state; Store retains owner-scoped relationships and manifests; an application-owned PostgreSQL catalog is a disposable, rebuildable query projection and must never query or modify LangGraph internal tables. Do not infer a primary workspace or authorization to clone, bind, or modify it. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

todos.content: Design a clear human-controlled review surface for sessions and workspaces showing names, editable summaries, observed active time, pauses, every participating agent profile and delegation, decisions, outcomes, artifacts, and cross-workspace relationships without productivity scoring or coercive optimization.
todos.notes: Implementation began 2026-08-02 as a visual-pane session library using TanStack Table, React Query Builder, TanStack Query, and nuqs rather than a custom grid or filter language. The human must be able to inspect, correct, export, archive, and apply retention choices to their own knowledge-work record. Observed, idle, paused, and inferred time must remain distinguishable. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

todos.content: Define a workspace- and session-linked model-use evidence ledger that records model/provider, local or cloud execution, agent profile, workflow version, measured versus estimated tokens and resources, verification outcomes, and human selection decisions.
todos.notes: Use the ledger to help the human identify when deterministic workflows and as-built knowledge make a smaller model sufficient. Jasper may explain or recommend; only the model selector or an explicitly approved agent profile selects. Prefer existing local capacity, never encourage hardware purchase, never silently load or switch models, and never turn minimum compute into a score imposed on the human. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

todos.content: Complete Coding and Research voice routing, Jasper specialist narration handoff, long-playback stability, local-model isolation, and concise recoverable failure handling.
todos.notes: Coding=Murrow_2 and Research/reference/Fact-Checker=Lorde routing, three-minute queue stability, cloud-only endpoint isolation, recoverable malformed visuals, provider sanitization, and durable voice manifests are implemented and tested. Restarted the UI and sidecar persistently, verified UI HTTP 200, 34 voices including Murrow_2 and Lorde, and generated 164,980 bytes of SSE audio for a short Murrow_2 smoke phrase without an LLM call. The requested devstral-small-2:24b-cloud entry was briefly configured but removed after the authoritative Ollama CLI reported that devstral-small-2:24b was retired on 2026-07-15; authenticated Cloud discovery currently offers qwen3.5:397b and kimi-k2.7-code as coding models. Unloaded mistral-small:22b from GPU and verified ollama ps is empty. Reverted an incorrect Cloud-only sidecar policy attempt: the sidecar remains discovery-only, while agent profiles and the UI selector own model choice. On 2026-08-02, repaired the reproducibility defect that allowed uv sync to remove manually installed Kyutai dependencies: pinned pocket-tts 2.1.0 in the sidecar extra and lockfile, which durably includes safetensors and its declared runtime dependencies. Pocket TTS is now explicitly moved to CPU and refuses startup if its parameters remain on another device. Verified 34 live voices, 19 SSE chunks from Juno_2, empty Ollama residency, no TTS GPU residency, two CPU-contract tests, and all 148 backend tests. A real segmented Jasper-to-specialist narration handoff still needs an end-to-end live assertion before this item can be completed. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

todos.content: Run focused unit and browser regressions, full backend and frontend suites, then all fifteen real smoke checks in order without mocked routes or dev-only runtime overrides.
todos.notes: Historical gates passed the frontend production build, generated-schema checks, TypeScript, 27 Playwright tests, Research citations, and Research visual placement. The latest focused Jasper suite passed 52 tests and an earlier full backend run passed 236. This gate is currently open: live repository grounding passes, but grounded visualization regressed—Jasper reads repository files without calling draw_concept_map or publishing an artifact. The final ordered no-mock sweep must be rerun after the Jasper contract is corrected, and still requires the segmented handoff and continuous real three-minute audio run. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

todos.content: Ensure every submitted Agent Server run uses the model currently shown by the UI selector, preserve that selection consistently across thread changes and refreshes, and prevent a cloud-selected session from silently loading any local Ollama model.
todos.notes: Confirmed production defect on 2026-08-03: the selector's React-only choice was discarded on refresh and stale checkpoint model state submitted ollama/qwen3.5:27b despite a visible cloud selection, loading 16 GB into GPU memory. Corrected the ownership boundary by persisting every explicit selector change immediately as owner-scoped LangGraph Store preference data. Checkpoint model remains execution history and no longer drives the selector. Deployed the canonical Agent Server and optimized UI, verified the preference route, UI HTTP 200, durable runtime identity, and empty ollama ps after unloading the unintended model. Validation passed: 37 focused backend tests, TypeScript, and the production frontend build. The human must make one explicit selection after this migration because no prior Store preference existed; subsequent refreshes and thread changes restore it.

todos.content: Fix normal Agent Server execution without allow-blocking, Python 3.11 schema compatibility, stale-thread recovery, and prevent internal JSON/tool envelopes from leaking into visible chat.
todos.notes: Removed the blocking eager workspace fallback, migrated runtime TypedDict schemas to typing_extensions, sanitized stale-thread and provider errors, stopped subgraph streaming, filtered outer messages to the final assistant response, and defaulted internal tool calls to hidden. Verified on the normal Agent Server without allow-blocking and with focused envelope regressions.

todos.content: Make the selected repository readable through the grounded Explainer boundary, render validated request-flow artifacts, preserve them across modes and refresh, and restore functional split-pane resizing.
todos.notes: Separated host repository tools from Deep Agents virtual filesystem names, added bounded safe repository listing, preserved validated artifacts in outer state, added deterministic grounded request-flow recovery, disabled pointer events on hidden mobile panes, and verified real evidence plus browser artifact recall, node labels, pane modes, composer visibility, and a genuine 100-pixel divider drag. Follow-up regression on 2026-07-31 found get_user_query ignored LangChain HumanMessage objects, disabling deterministic grounding and visual intent detection. The adapter now supports dict and BaseMessage forms; mandatory repository preflight and sanitized jasper_debug evidence diagnostics were added. Studio debug streaming then observed list_repository_files, read_repository_file, and draw_concept_map across nested Jasper/model/tools namespaces. Dynamic supervisor destinations were declared so Studio renders all specialist routes. Final live visual used 13 evidence sources, returned one artifact, and had no diagnostic error.

todos.content: Bound Research and Fact-Checker connector/model fan-out, handle rate limits efficiently, retain clickable citations, and place requested structured comparisons in the visual surface.
todos.notes: Wired profile model/tool call limits into middleware, added configurable 45-second Research and 25-second verification ceilings, retained fail-closed numbered citations, and generated validated evidence-linked comparison artifacts for the visual pane. Live checks returned seven references in 75.5 seconds and a visual artifact; ceilings were tightened afterward and unit/browser contracts pass.

todos.content: Remove repository preloading and require Jasper to perform real repository tool calls before publishing one validated parent-level concept map.
todos.notes: Do not synthesize missing artifacts or treat deterministic preflight as proof of Jasper tool use. Removed Jasper's call-limit middleware and tools-disabled recovery call so the standard create_agent ReAct loop owns tool execution and completion. After restart, live grounded visual thread 019fbb51-c590-7013-a629-a55f9b42daff successfully called repository tools and registered eight evidence sources, but ollama-cloud/glm-5.1 returned a final assistant preamble ('Let me now construct...') instead of a draw_concept_map tool call. Artifact count remained zero. No custom limit or recovery middleware participated in this run. On 2026-08-03 Jasper's execution loop was migrated to the documented create_deep_agent harness with read-only FilesystemBackend discovery tools, direct grounded visualization and todo tools, and Research and approval-gated Coding as CompiledSubAgent specialists through the standard task tool. The obsolete eight-call ceiling and ordinary Research wrapper were removed. The compiled tool surface and a real built-in ls execution are covered by tests; 168 backend tests pass. Keep this todo in progress until a live selected-provider repository-grounded visualization passes. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

todos.content: Verify Jasper's exact visible tools, repository grounding, visual publication, sanitized failure behavior, and Agent Server traces with real smoke prompts.
todos.notes: Mock-only tests are insufficient; completion requires live runtime evidence. Jasper now uses the standard create_agent loop, is the default supervisor, and has Research and approval-gated Coding through SubAgentMiddleware. The compiled graph exposes the expected ten direct tools plus task. Focused tests and lint pass, and the restarted API is healthy. Live visual thread 019fbb51-c590-7013-a629-a55f9b42daff still failed because ollama-cloud/glm-5.1 emitted final text instead of calling the registered draw_concept_map tool; no artifact was published. The 2026-08-03 implementation now uses create_deep_agent directly and exposes exactly draw_concept_map, list_todos, read_repository_file, read_file, ls, glob, grep, and task; Research and Coding are named compiled subagents. Unit and graph validation passes, but this release gate remains pending until the same surface is observed in Agent Server traces with a real model and a visual artifact is published. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

todos.content: Remove the Explainer agent and give Jasper one explicit model-visible tool contract for safe repository reads, general visual publication, Research delegation, memory, and profile handoff.
todos.notes: Replaced the custom JasperToolContractMiddleware and hidden task rejection with an agent-scoped LangChain create_agent graph plus the official Deep Agents SubAgentMiddleware. Removed duplicate per-repository-tool limits, the Jasper call-limit middleware, and the tools-disabled recovery call. Jasper is now the default supervisor with Research and approval-gated Coding as its two declared compiled subagents. Compiled ToolNode inspection proves exactly Jasper's ten declared direct tools plus task, with no general-purpose, filesystem, execute, or direct network tools. Focused graph tests and lint pass.

sections.title: Live Smoke Remediation and Profile-Aware Voice Playback

todos.content: Transport structured specialist narration through Jasper delegation so Jasper can introduce the work with sufficient context in Jasper's voice, then replay the specialist's bounded voice-safe segments in that specialist's voice with artifact, claim, citation, node, thread, and checkpoint provenance.
todos.notes: Use the existing renderer-neutral NarrationTrack/NarrationCue contract and LangGraph thread/checkpoint state; do not split speakers with regexes or duplicate raw tool output into chat. Desired library handoff recorded 2026-08-02: Jasper neutrally checks understanding when intent is not already clear, explicitly introduces the Research transition (for example, 'let me run to the library'), and retains Jasper-authored context in the Jasper voice. Research returns typed specialist narration with speaker_profile=research plus separate reference/list/visual artifacts; the UI gives those segments visible Research provenance and TTS uses the configured Research voice. Node deep dives must preserve artifact provenance and let the human explicitly continue with Research, Coding, Jasper, or another available profile rather than inferring a handoff from attention alone. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

todos.content: Represent every Research search as a durable, timestamped visual-board pass containing clickable numbered references, short source summaries, explicit page-read versus search-snippet or retrieval-failure status, and stable claim-to-reference links showing exactly where each source supports the response.
todos.notes: Extend rather than replace dual-channel-citation-experience and research-citation-verification-release-gate. Use LangChain ToolMessage artifacts for full connector metadata and a LangGraph Command/state update for the typed ResearchPass artifact; persist pass identity and session/artifact relationships through the existing durable Store boundary. Render concise numbered citations in text and full cards in the visual board, grouped by RFC 3339 date/time, with parent/deep-dive links between passes. Use CSL-JSON-compatible bibliographic metadata for citation rendering/export and W3C PROV-inspired activity/entity provenance. Never label a URL as read unless a retrieval tool actually returned usable page content; distinguish discovered, snippet-only, read, partial, and failed states. Citation selection must focus the associated stable response or narration segment, and URLs must not be spoken. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

todos.content: Remove the obsolete Kokoro TTS implementation and dependency graph so Pocket TTS is the repository's only active speech-synthesis engine.
todos.notes: Confirmed the legacy tts.py implementation and runtime imports were already absent, removed Kokoro from the sidecar dependency declaration, and regenerated uv.lock. The lock cleanup removed Kokoro and its 38 exclusive transitive packages, including the incompatible legacy Transformers branch. Repository search finds no Kokoro, KPipeline, or src.tts references; uv lock validation and both Pocket TTS CPU-safety tests pass. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

todos.content: Verify against the production UI and real sidecar that a selected Ollama Cloud model survives refresh without falling back to a local model.
todos.notes: Verified in an isolated browser against the live production UI and real model sidecar: ollama-cloud/glm-5.2 remained selected in the control and localStorage after refresh. The full 27-test browser suite also passes.

todos.content: Make malformed visualization tool arguments recoverable inside Jasper's LangChain agent loop so one rejected tool payload cannot abort the complete response.
todos.notes: Changed ToolRetryMiddleware failure handling from run-aborting error propagation to a sanitized corrective ToolMessage, allowing Jasper to repair invalid visualization arguments without exposing model/provider payloads. Added regression coverage.

todos.content: Recover validated authoritative connector records into numbered clickable references when Research structured synthesis fails, and never expose an uncited model draft as sourced research or render inline charts in chat.
todos.notes: Research now recovers validated ConnectorResult records from real Deep Agents ToolMessages into stable claim-linked clickable references when structured synthesis fails. With no retrieved evidence it refuses to expose uncited draft prose. The Research profile explicitly forbids inline Mermaid, ASCII, and markdown-table charts.

todos.content: Attribute assistant messages and narration segments to their speaker profile; use Murrow_2 for Coding and Lorde for Research, references, and Fact-Checker playback while Jasper retains the user's Jasper voice.
todos.notes: Added stable defaults Coding=Murrow_2 and Research/reference/Fact-Checker=Lorde. Outer LangGraph messages preserve speaker_profile metadata; chat playback and code-architecture narration resolve specialist voices while Jasper retains its selected voice. Browser coverage verifies Lorde routing, and the performance gate confirms historical rows remain memoized.

todos.content: Enforce the documented Ollama Cloud limitation: never send native structured-output format or response_format parameters to ollama-cloud models. Generate instructed JSON as ordinary text, extract one bounded JSON object deterministically, validate it with Pydantic, perform bounded schema-directed repair, and fail closed for Jasper, Research, and Fact-Checker.
todos.notes: Confirmed against Ollama's official Structured Outputs documentation. Added a provider guard that forces ollama-cloud models onto ordinary instructed JSON text, bounded object extraction, Pydantic validation, two-attempt field/type-directed repair, and fail-closed fallback. Jasper cannot select ProviderStrategy/ToolStrategy for Cloud; Research and Fact-Checker omit Deep Agents response_format for Cloud. Full backend suite passes: 220 tests.

todos.content: Add a versioned voice manifest to the durable ExplainerSession design. Persist semantic speaker_profile on every narration segment plus the session-time profile-to-voice snapshot, support original-voice and current-preference replay modes, and define missing-voice fallback without mutating immutable artifacts.
todos.notes: Added an immutable, versioned VoiceManifest to ExplainerSession with a session-time profile-to-voice snapshot, original/current-preference replay modes, deterministic missing-voice fallback, generated JSON Schema and TypeScript contracts, and resolver tests. NarrationSegment continues to persist semantic speaker_profile rather than synthesized audio or prose-derived identity.

todos.content: Add a real Agent Server release gate for selected-repository architecture summaries, grounded visual artifact persistence, citation panels, and profile-aware audio. Use a non-secret fixture repository or explicit authorization before sending repository content to any cloud model.
todos.notes: Ran the real local Agent Server against the user-authorized repository and configured Ollama Cloud provider. Jasper returned grounded architecture evidence with no invalid_workspace, and a freshly restarted server returned one validated request-flow artifact with 11 nodes and seven real source files. Live Research returned seven stable clickable references without URLs in voice text and a visual-surface artifact.

todos.content: Reproduce the transient graph-over-chat frame in a fresh production UI thread and capture the workspace mode, panel dimensions, React Flow viewport readiness, and artifact arrival order before and after the first render.
todos.notes: Acceptance evidence: a timestamped browser trace or frame sequence identifies the first invalid layout transition; do not change CSS or panel state before the cause is observed. Compare against React Flow viewport/node initialization and react-resizable-panels documented SSR layout behavior. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

Acceptance: every node-based concept-map smoke fixture renders left-to-right, with no model-dependent orientation. Decide the contract before editing schema or renderer code. Cross-reference visual-model-tool-capability-matrix-and-guidance. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

todos.content: Verify the existing narration-to-node contract end to end: message playback follows narration_order, emits each artifact and node ID, highlights exactly one matching node, and clears the highlight when playback stops.
todos.notes: The current implementation already dispatches visual:narration-node and renders an active-node ring. Measure it before extending it. todos.notes: Acceptance: document one chosen behavior and its tradeoff, then test that the active node is visible at readable scale during narration. No implementation until the existing highlight behavior and initial-layout trace are measured. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

todos.content: After the preceding evidence is complete, apply only the smallest documentation-supported corrections and run fresh-artifact, mode-switch, refresh-recall, horizontal-layout, narration-highlight, cancellation, and manual-pan regression tests.

todos.content: Replace oversized white tool-call, tool-result, and Research reference cards with one compact semantic dark-red card treatment that avoids abrupt contrast in both light and dark modes.
todos.notes: Added shared activity-card color tokens with muted burgundy surfaces, softened foregrounds and borders for both themes. Applied the compact treatment to Agent Chat UI tool calls/results and visual-board source/reference cards, reducing maximum width, padding, typography, and expansion-control height. Focused lint, TypeScript, Prettier, and diff checks pass. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

sections.title: Intent-Aware Narration and Visual Tool Reliability

todos.content: Investigate and prove repeated draw_concept_map tool invocation and artifact publication within the same Jasper thread before enabling any automatic visual policy.
todos.notes: Production evidence from fork 9b24745a-3d27-4b3a-b1d4-6ac8f8abaf6c disproved the suspected one-visual-per-session rule: no such prompt, schema, processor, or tool language exists. The failed SIFT turn exhausted a global ToolCallLimitMiddleware after repeated Jina 403 responses before draw_concept_map. The documented LangChain supervisor pattern is now restored: Jasper owns draw_concept_map and delegates external evidence to a Research subagent tool; Research owns Tavily web_search and Jina read_url. A second regression was found in ToolRetryMiddleware(on_failure=error), which aborted malformed visual arguments instead of returning a corrective ToolMessage, and a third in get_user_query, which ignored HumanMessage objects produced by LangGraph add_messages and therefore failed to register user-input evidence. Focused validation passes (76 tests). Live production thread 019fc3f8-9278-7043-815c-9ee5784bddb2 using ollama-cloud/glm-5.2 and the two-pass strategy created map A (visual-d7919574f3f54f7c808d48689698abdd), then delegated SIFT research and created distinct grounded map B (visual-658843f0fe7d4a04ad253d12d05ecde6) with eight web evidence records. The production session catalog returns both artifacts after the second turn. Production fork a258c65e-78e3-4cb3-ad78-e34256295f3e retained both inherited maps and successfully created a third distinct Plan-Act-Review map (visual-40f017df424a45b69b7b3d72be4a7592); its catalog reports two inherited artifacts and one created artifact. Remaining acceptance: focus or revise map A, refresh the UI, and recall all artifacts without substitution or loss. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

todos.content: Render model narration as a clickable sentence-level transcript linked to stable NarrationCue segment IDs.
todos.notes: Acceptance: each visible sentence maps to exactly one replayable cue, and selecting a sentence starts playback from that sentence without duplicating the response or node narration. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

todos.content: Expose the exact transcript sentence currently being spoken using authoritative playback state rather than elapsed-time guessing.
todos.notes: Acceptance: the indicator advances only when the corresponding cue begins, remains correct through pause and resume, and clears on stop, cancellation, completion, or playback failure. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

todos.content: Support pause, resume, and playback beginning from any sentence in the transcript.
todos.notes: Use the renderer-neutral NarrationTrack/NarrationCue contract and retained audio/playback offsets. Acceptance requires correct continuation after pause and deterministic restart from every tested sentence. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

todos.content: Add soft, visually calm highlighting transitions for the active transcript sentence and its associated visual node.
todos.notes: Avoid harsh borders, flashing, rapid animation, and forced viewport movement. Respect reduced-motion preferences and verify that presentation changes never alter artifact content. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

todos.content: Represent node selection as evidence of human attention, never as authorization or an instruction that silently overrides the human's written or spoken prompt.
todos.notes: Persist active artifact and selected node as typed context distinct from messages and consent state. A related prompt may use the context; an unrelated or ambiguous prompt must not be reinterpreted to fit the selection. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

todos.content: When selected-node context conflicts with or is ambiguous relative to the next prompt, pause and ask a neutral clarification before changing focus or acting.
todos.notes: Use a typed LangGraph interrupt with equally presented choices such as this node, another visual area, a side question, or a different concept/session. Silence and inaction are not consent; no option is inferred or preselected. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

todos.content: Human editors must ratify the communication constitution, authority tiers, amendment process, non-waivable protections, scoped exceptions, and constitution-version migration behavior for existing sessions.
todos.notes: Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md. The model may surface tensions and draft language but cannot approve or activate the framework.

todos.content: Define the machine-readable governance rule registry with stable rule IDs, versions, authority tier, waiver policy, affected typed state fields, enforcement conditions, interrupt behavior, and linked scenarios.
todos.notes: The registry must fail closed if it disagrees with the ratified human-readable constitution. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

todos.content: Create the source manifest for Martin, Rosenberg, Brignull, and future sources with provenance, rights, approved passages, human editorial interpretations, disagreements, limitations, rule breadcrumbs, and review history.
todos.notes: The Store is an active case-law reasoning layer but remains subordinate to the constitution. Human editorial approval is required before publication. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

todos.content: Design and validate the governed source-ingestion pipeline for EPUB, PDF, HTML, Markdown, DOCX, JSON, and audio using appropriate LangChain loaders, OCR, or speech transcription with mandatory human review before indexing.
todos.notes: Every searchable passage must link backward to provenance and editorial interpretation and forward to rule IDs, state fields, enforcement conditions, scenarios, and implementation todos. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

todos.content: Build a human-reviewed scenario suite covering coercion, ambiguity, consent, authorization, memory, sessions, selected-node context, tool actions, refusal, revocation, silence, deceptive choices, and evaluator disagreement.
todos.notes: Use deterministic tests for procedural invariants, model evaluations for semantic risk, and human editorial review for normative ambiguity. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

todos.content: Define an append-only governance audit event contract and durable storage boundary that records constitution version, triggered rule IDs, interrupt choices, explicit human decisions, and resulting transitions without unnecessary private content.
todos.notes: LangGraph checkpoints and LangSmith traces are useful evidence but are not the authoritative consent and governance ledger. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

todos.content: Establish a governance review gate requiring protected behavior, state transitions, interrupt language, and relevant implementation todos to cite GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md and stable rule IDs before release.
todos.notes: Cross-reference existing todos clickable-sentence-transcript, exact-current-sentence-indicator, pause-resume-and-sentence-start, soft-transcript-and-node-highlighting, node-selection-is-attention-not-authorization, neutral-node-prompt-clarification, and repeat-visual-tool-calls-in-one-thread rather than duplicating them.

todos.content: Keep runtime governance enforcement disabled until human editors approve the charter baseline and repeated Jasper visualization-tool invocation, revision, publication, refresh, and recall pass independently in one thread.
todos.notes: Depends on ratify-constitution-authority-and-migration and the existing repeat-visual-tool-calls-in-one-thread todo. Do not hide tool failures behind ethical middleware or recovery behavior. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

todos.content: Evaluate and define a grounded spec-first workflow, including whether spec-kit fits, so Jasper helps the human vet documentation, architecture, scope, and ethical implications before expensive Coding work begins.
todos.notes: The purpose is informed direction and controlled scope, not an assumption that the human wants the fastest, simplest, cheapest, or lowest-token answer. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

todos.content: Define human-controlled engagement modes, checks for understanding, and visual decision-tree behavior so Jasper can support delegated work or concept-by-concept participation without choosing the level of involvement for the human.
todos.notes: Connect this work to the durable session, visual artifact, selected-node, transcript, and narration contracts. Long responses are evaluated for comprehensibility and voluntary engagement, not length alone. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

todos.content: Define an early-stage solution evaluation framework that surfaces accessibility and compares open-source and proprietary options by ownership, privacy, cost, maintenance, accessibility, and fitness without substituting one automatic default for another.
todos.notes: Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md. The human retains the decision after seeing documented tradeoffs.

todos.content: Define human editorial governance for curated intellectual lenses, including writers such as Baldwin and Lorde, with provenance, context, disagreement, limitations, representation review, and an explicit boundary between expanding perspective and prescribing belief.
todos.notes: The model may retrieve and compare approved lenses but may not flatten distinct traditions into interchangeable advice or promote them into constitutional authority. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

todos.content: Research and human-review Jasper's non-therapy boundary, educational discussion of therapeutic modalities, appropriate-care referrals, urgent-risk handling, jurisdictional resources, and language that avoids both therapeutic impersonation and abrupt rejection of ordinary emotional conversation.
todos.notes: This is high-stakes policy work. Use current authoritative clinical and public-health sources, record jurisdiction and review dates, and require human editorial approval before runtime use. Governance reference: GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md.

todos.content: Create the root-level GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK.md working draft that records the human-protection mission, adopted governance direction, source foundations, technical boundaries, and unresolved editorial questions.

sections.title: Tent Poles — Memory Layer with Tools + Dashboard

todos.content: Design and document the Tent Poles memory layer: collaborative context compaction where Jasper proposes key load-bearing points (tent poles), user reviews/prioritizes, approved tent poles replace old messages. Concept doc with data structure, flow, storage, tools, UI, and open questions.
todos.notes: Concept designed. Tent poles = structural key points (decisions, facts, preferences, open questions, constraints). User co-creates and prioritizes. Replaces narrative summarization with collaborative context curation.

todos.content: DECISION: JSON file (tent_poles.json) at repo root — same proven pattern as todos.json. Survives restarts, simple to debug, no Docker/Postgres dependency. Migrate to LangGraph Store later for cross-thread semantic search if needed. Implement read/write helpers for tent_poles.json. Add GET /api/tent-poles endpoint to FastAPI sidecar (web_server.py) mirroring /api/todos pattern. Schema: {version, updated_at, updated_by, tent_poles: [{id, content, priority, scope: 'global'|'thread', thread_id?, created_at, updated_at}]}.
todos.notes: Implemented a validated TentPoleStore over root tent_poles.json with inter-process shared/exclusive locking, same-directory atomic replacement, file and directory fsync, restrictive permissions, scoped querying, mutation, and atomic batch reprioritization. Added GET/POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE FastAPI contracts with validation and stable errors.

todos.content: Phase 4: Define 4 LangChain @tool functions for tent pole management in backend/src/jasper_tools.py (NOT 5 — propose_tent_poles DROPPED per user decision). Tools: (1) set_tent_pole(content: str, priority: int, scope: str = 'global') -> str — add a tent pole; (2) update_tent_pole(id: str, content: str = '', priority: int = -1) -> str — edit/reprioritize; (3) remove_tent_pole(id: str) -> str — drop; (4) get_tent_poles(scope: str = 'all', thread_id: str = '') -> list[dict] — read current set. Tools read/write tent_poles.json. Jasper extracts key points IN-RESPONSE (not via a separate tool), presents to user, user approves on next turn, Jasper calls set_tent_pole for each approved item. Depends on jasper-react-loop.
todos.notes: Added the four specified LangChain tools with exact collaborative semantics, thread context isolation, stable JSON results, missing-ID handling, and active-only reads. Registered them in Jasper and the strict profile contract; no proposal-writing tool was introduced.

todos.content: DECISION: Second tab in existing right sidebar (next to Todos). Adapt todos/index.tsx pattern. Add tab toggle between 'Todos' and 'Tent Poles' panels. Poll /api/tent-poles every 3s (same as todos). Display tent poles grouped by scope (global vs current thread). Show: content, priority (sortable), scope badge. Inline edit for content. Drag-to-reorder for priority. Approve/reject buttons for pending proposals. Pending review indicator (badge count) in tab header.
todos.notes: Added a Todos/Tent Poles tabbed sidebar with global/thread grouping, scope/status badges, pending count, inline editing, proposal approve/reject, and drag reorder backed by one atomic priority transaction. Polling runs only while the sidebar is open. Playwright covers review, edit, approval, and reorder.

todos.content: DECISION: Hybrid scope — global facts (user preferences, project facts, long-term decisions) + per-thread decisions (conversation-specific choices). Schema: tent pole has scope field ('global' or 'thread') and optional thread_id field (set when scope='thread'). Jasper reads both global and current-thread tent poles into context. Global tent poles persist across all conversations. Per-thread tent poles only loaded for their originating thread. get_tent_poles tool accepts scope filter ('all', 'global', 'thread') and thread_id parameter.
todos.notes: Enforced hybrid scope in Pydantic and storage validators: global entries cannot carry thread IDs, thread entries require one, and all/current-thread reads combine global entries only with the selected thread. Jasper tools derive thread identity from run-scoped context rather than process globals.

todos.content: DECISION: Auto-offer at message threshold (20+ messages in conversation) + manual trigger anytime via /tentpoles command. When threshold reached, Jasper's system prompt instructs it to offer: 'I've noticed we've discussed several things — would you like me to summarize the key points?' Jasper extracts key points in response text, user reviews/approves, Jasper calls set_tent_pole for approved items. Manual trigger: user types /tentpoles, Jasper immediately proposes. Collaborative, not silent — user always in the loop.
todos.notes: Implemented deterministic /tentpoles proposal prompting and a persisted one-time offer at 20 human/assistant messages; tool messages do not inflate the threshold. Jasper is explicitly forbidden to persist silently and may call set_tent_pole only after approval. Unit tests cover manual, threshold, one-time, and tool-message behavior.

sections.title: UI Performance — Slow/Freeze Diagnosis and Fix Plan

todos.content: Diagnose and document root causes of UI slowness and freezing during agent responses. Three root causes identified: (1) No throttle on stream state updates — every LLM token triggers immediate React re-render. (2) MarkdownText re-parses entire accumulated content on every render — ReactMarkdown with remarkGfm + remarkMath + rehypeKatex is expensive per render. (3) onCustomEvent handler adds 'custom' to streamMode for ALL requests including Jasper — server sends custom events even when no agent emits them, adding SSE overhead.
todos.notes: Root causes found via LangGraph SDK source code analysis. StreamManager (manager.js) processes every token: messages.slice() copies full array, creates new state object, calls notifyListeners. With throttle:50 added, renders batched but state mutations still run per-token. callbackStreamMode (stream.lgp.js:146) auto-adds 'custom' mode when onCustomEvent is set — overhead on every request.

todos.content: Add throttle:50 to useTypedStream options in Stream.tsx. Batches React re-renders to max once per 50ms instead of every token. Applied — verify it helps with fast cloud models.
todos.notes: Added to Stream.tsx:112. Throttle batches renders but not state mutations. SDK source: StreamManager.subscribe (manager.js:287) uses setTimeout to defer listener calls. Helps but does not solve the core issue of per-token object creation.

todos.content: Consider increasing throttle from 50ms to 100-200ms. Reduces render frequency from 20fps to 5-10fps. Still smooth for reading streaming text but halves markdown re-parse cost. Simple one-line change in Stream.tsx.
todos.notes: Throttle increased from 50ms to 150ms in Stream.tsx:112. Verified in code during Phase 2 audit — value is already 150. Reconciled from pending to completed.

todos.content: Remove the onCustomEvent 'text' handler in Stream.tsx:128-129. Currently calls options.mutate() for every OpenCode text chunk, setting opencode_status='streaming' hundreds of times per second. The 'text' events are already streamed via messages stream mode. Only keep handlers for 'status', 'complete', 'error' events.
todos.notes: The 'text' branch is already removed from onCustomEvent in Stream.tsx. Handler now only covers 'complete' and 'error' events. Verified during Phase 2 audit. Reconciled from pending to completed.

todos.content: Memoize MarkdownText component more aggressively. Only render full markdown when message streaming is complete. During streaming, show raw text. When streaming completes, render parsed markdown. This eliminates per-render markdown re-parse during streaming.
todos.notes: MarkdownText now takes a streaming prop; ai.tsx passes streaming={isLoading && isLastMessage}. TypeScript compiles clean.

todos.content: Lazy-load remarkMath and rehypeKatex plugins in markdown-text.tsx. These are heavy and most messages contain no math. Load them only when LaTeX delimiters ($...$, $$...$$) are detected in content. Reduces initial parse cost for non-math messages significantly.
todos.notes: Audit correction (2026-07-30): plugin execution is conditional on math delimiters, but remark-math and rehype-katex remain static top-level imports in markdown-text.tsx. This avoids parsing non-math messages but does not lazy-load or remove the libraries from the initial module graph.

todos.notes: Fixed in agent-chat-ui/src/hooks/useTTS.ts. Two changes: (1) source.onended callback disconnects the node from the audio graph after playback, preventing accumulation. (2) Polling interval for playback completion increased from 100ms to 250ms to reduce timer overhead.
